interpretation: Representation diagnostics only. O(V(C)) measures learned value directions, not the actual attention-weighted state-dependent write. Content sensitivity and low cosine are not proofs of beneficial physical generation; use paired video scores and processes.
semantic_fit_scope: Existing native-word semantic auxiliary, not physical truth. Mean and centered errors exactly decompose its MSE; neither is a new training objective.
projection_parts_scope: Both operators act on the current learned Q update. The initializer term is not the full untrained model; FP32 linear decomposition may differ slightly from the recorded autocast output.
